metadata.description: dfm (dataflow marketing): marketing skills for Claude that keep a business's marketing context.

plugins.name: dfm-content
plugins.description: Words from the person's own: post-make makes a post from their words; quotes-check proves every quote, name, number and amount is in its source.

plugins.name: dfm-ghost
plugins.description: Ghost sites: site-add names a site and its key's variable in settings; post-draft puts a checked post on Ghost as a draft and reads it back.

plugins.name: dfm-recipes
plugins.description: Recipes that run skills in order: recording-run turns a recording into a draft post.
